config:automation.cfg.changes: First version: split from the old config:lab.cfg. The automation node's own identity (network, hostname, vm/container/kubernetes shape) -- needed regardless of whether a KVM host is even involved.

_automation_network added: "host" puts a container automation node on its host's own network (set automatically when the host has no bridge and is not a KVM host); empty or "bridge" keeps the bridge as before.

config:credentials.changes: scc gained scc_email/scc_url fields, so a host's SUSE registration email/URL can live in the encrypted credential store instead of plaintext in a config file.
Add the anthropic credential kind (anthropic_oauth_token, anthropic_api_key), for install_anthropic_tools.
Added the huggingface credential kind, for the token a gated model is downloaded with

config:kvm_host.cfg.changes: First version: split from the old config:lab.cfg. This host becoming a KVM hypervisor (bridge/NAT networking, storage, VM-build specifics) -- needed only when setup_kvm_node.py actually prepares a KVM host.

config:lab-registry.json.changes: First version: one file per deployed lab under /etc/lab_creation/labs, holding the lab's name, its definition's path, its DNS zone and its nodes, so a scheduled run knows which labs exist.

config:lab_creation.cfg.changes: Add optional CLOUD_DNS_IMAGE: the image the cloud DNS VM boots from.
REMOTE_DNS_SERVERS documented: the other DNS servers that are masters of this node's zone, which every record is written into as well.
Add optional EXAMPLE_LABS_DIR: the operator's own example labs, listed beside the ones lab-in-a-box ships.

MCP_CLIENTS and MCP_ISSUER_URL: the MCP endpoint's per-client bearer tokens. Both optional, and a read-only endpoint needs neither; enabling MCP_ALLOW_MUTATIONS now requires at least one registered client, so a caller that can destroy a lab is identifiable.
LAB_REGISTRY_DIR and LAB_EVENT_LOG: where this automation node records the labs it has deployed, and the log of every action taken on one.

config:mcp-clients.json.changes: First version: the MCP client registry. Each entry names a client, the SHA-256 of its bearer token, and its scopes (read, or read and write for the mutating tools).

lab.changes: Add optional kclusters.clu_token: the join token set on the first rke2/k3s server.
open_ports and aws_open_ports (common and per-node) are declared as the lists every backend reads them as, instead of strings
pre_commands and post_commands: shell commands a VM runs itself, before any other work and after all of it
lab_description in common: one line saying what a lab is for, shown where labs are listed
clu_type kubeadm (upstream Kubernetes built with kubeadm), with clu_cni and clu_pod_cidr for the network plugin it applies.
kclusters gains clu_ingress and clu_storage: the ingress controller and default storage class of a cluster, installed as add-ons when its distribution brings none
nodes.myip is optional: an address is allocated from the network the lab already describes when the definition gives none

ISO_URL and ISO_SHA256_URL declared again, hidden and deprecated: setup_lab.py still downloads them. A URL in SOURCE_IMAGE is downloaded the same way, once into ISO_LOC on each KVM host and checked against SOURCE_SHA256, which it requires.

A disabled_nodes section, in the same form as nodes, for nodes that are part of a lab's design but are not deployed: nothing reads it, so a node waiting on an image or a release stays in the file instead of being deleted. SOURCE_IMAGE also accepts a cloud provider's own image ID or a product name ("slmicro6.1", "sles16", "ubuntu24.04", see libs/cloud_images.py), resolved to the provider's current image for the node's architecture at create time.

INSTALL_RKE2_TYPE, ISO_IMAGE, ISO_URL, ISO_SHA256 and ISO_SHA256_URL removed from common and nodes: their values move to KUBERNETES_NODE_TYPE, SOURCE_IMAGE (a URL itself, downloaded under the URL's own file name) and SOURCE_SHA256. setup_lab.py, setup_vm.py and setup_automation_node.py now apply a pending migration themselves, warn per change and continue with the migrated sibling file.
ssh_authorized_keys in common and nodes: extra SSH keys (a key, an https URL or a file path; for root or a named user) added to each VM once it is up.

Declare aws_nested_virtualization in common and per node: an AWS-only knob the backend and the Harvester helper already read, and that examples/harvester-aws.json.template already sets, but the schema did not list
clu_type kubeadm is now clu_type vanilla: the same upstream Kubernetes built with kubeadm, under the name the lab definition and the documentation use for it. A lab naming the old value is migrated.

Declare static_ip in common and per node: on a cloud backend "true" reserves a VM's public address with the provider, so a stop and start hands back the same address instead of a new one that leaves every record of the lab naming an address that answers nothing
